free_tier_limits.correction: For 12 months after account signup: 1,000 images/month for Image APIs (DetectLabels, DetectModerationLabels, DetectText, DetectFaces, RecognizeCelebrities, CompareFaces), 1,000 face metadata storage months, 1,000 face vector searches/month for Face Liveness; Video (stored) free tier also available — see current pricing page for exact video limits. Free tier is time-limited (12 months), not forever.

rate_limits.correction: AWS publishes default service quotas (throttling limits) for Rekognition; limits vary by API and region and can be viewed/requested in Service Quotas. Not 'not published' — e.g. DetectLabels and many image APIs have documented default TPS/transaction quotas per account/region.
